title: Tamil Literary KnowledgeHub: Thevaram 1-8 Corpus Resource and Tools
description: A provenance-preserving Tamil literary corpus resource and reusable processing toolkit for Thevaram books 1-8, derived from Tamil Virtual Academy/TamilVU source pages. The repository includes normalized JSONL tables, schemas, documentation, checksums, audit reports, source URLs, an audited Irandaam Thirumurai subset, and reuse instructions. Source text is attributed to Tamil Virtual Academy/TamilVU and may be subject to separate rights.
